The balance sheet looks solid for an investment-grade issuer: liquidity is adequate (current ratio 1.34), leverage is moderate (liabilities about 51% of assets), and the company has a strong accumulated equity/retained earnings base. Profitability is respectable but not exceptionally strong relative to the asset base, so the profile fits the lower end of the “A” category rather than the high-grade “AA” range.

DECISION: A-
